comment: Content-Security-Policy for the app pages, written by tools/make_editions.py. index.html and lite.html get it as a <meta> tag; byo.html (PC only) gets it from js/byo-csp.js, which adds the origins of the feeds the user has saved on this computer. Each outside host is here for one stated reason. Production pages allow no localhost and no inline styles: 'style_hashes' are the three fixed <style> blocks the bundled globe.gl library inserts, plus the empty block it inserts first. Test servers (serve.py with SEAGLOBE_TEST_CSP=1, tools/check_grokme_lite.mjs) add 'test_hosts' to the policy they serve; the files on disk never contain them.
byo_note: byo.html runs from this computer (127.0.0.1), so it may also reach feeds on this computer (byo_local_connect) plus the exact origins of the TLE URL and receiver URL the user saved; a new origin takes effect after a reload.
